openwrt_git.titel: ath79: add support for Sophos AP100/AP55 family
gemeinsam: Qualcomm QCA9558 SoC @ 720 MHz (MIPS 74Kc Big-endian processor)
Green and Red status LEDs sharing a single external light-pipe
Alternate power supply via 5.5x2.1mm DC jack @ 12 VDC
ap100_ap55: USB 2.0 Type A port, power controlled via GPIO 11
openwrt_git.hardwaregleich: The AP100 and AP100C are hardware-identical to the AP55 and AP55C, however the 55 models' ART does not contain calibration data for their third chain despite it being present on the PCB.
openwrt_git.flash_xg: Sophos SG/XG appliance -> awetool -> SSH auf AP -> mtd -r write /tmp/openwrt.bin astaro_image
openwrt_git.flash_uboot: TFTP-Server 192.168.99.8/24, Datei umbenennen in 'uImage_AP100C' (Beispiel), tftpboot; cp.b $fileaddr 0x9f070000 $filesize; boot
openwrt_git.mac_bestaetigt: three AP55C, two AP55, and one AP100C

fussnoten.1: Button is present but does not alter state of any GPIO on SoC
fussnoten.2: Buzzer and driver circuitry is present on PCB but is not connected to any GPIO. Shorting an unpopulated resistor next to the driver circuitry should connect the buzzer to GPIO 4, but this is unconfirmed.
fussnoten.3: This external RJ45 serial port is disabled in the OEM firmware, but works in OpenWRT without additional configuration
fussnoten.4: On AP100/AP55 models the UART header is accessible after removing the device's top cover. Pin 1 is marked on the silkscreen. Pins from 1-4 are 3.3V, GND, TX, RX

installation.wert: über RJ45-Konsole + TFTP: PC 192.168.99.8/24, ath> tftpboot (holt uImage_AP55 = initramfs-kernel, Ladeadresse 0x81000000), setenv fwaddr 0x9f070000, erase $fwaddr +$filesize, cp.b $fileaddr $fwaddr $filesize, iminfo $fwaddr, boot; danach sysupgrade
U-Boot: tftpboot; cp.b $fileaddr 0x9f070000 $filesize; boot - oder über Sophos SG/XG-Appliance: awetool -> SSH -> mtd -r write /tmp/openwrt.bin astaro_image
Kategorie B: serieller Zugang + TFTP-initramfs, dann sysupgrade; Gluon baut kein Factory-Image
Herstellersoftware oder TFTP+Seriell; kein Factory-Image (factory = false)
